premises.text: Many aspiring music artists lack access to quality producers or cannot afford to pursue a career in music
premises.evidence_span: However, they either don't have access to quality producers, or they can't afford to pursue a career in music

premises.text: Rekrogram provides an all-in-one mobile production marketplace for creating original songs
premises.evidence_span: Rekrogram is an all-in-one mobile production marketplace, a recording studio, and a social network that allows our users to create original songs with award-winning music producers for under $5

premises.text: Users can discover beats, write songs, record songs, and shoot videos all within the Rekrogram platform
premises.evidence_span: Our users can discover beats, they can write songs to those beats, they can record songs to those beats, and they can also shoot a video to that song that they just created

premises.text: Rekrogram connects producers with aspiring artists, enabling collaboration and discovery
premises.evidence_span: Rekrogram solves both Tony and Willie's problems. We're the user-friendly, convenient, and affordable solution that connects producer Tony with aspiring artist Willie

premises.text: Producers can monetize their beats through a subscription model and revenue sharing
premises.evidence_span: we charge producers $9.99 a month or $90 a year to upload our beats to our platform. And when those beats are leased or sold through our platform, we take 20% of the in-app purchase and we provide 50% of the royalties back to the producer

premises.text: Rekrogram is positioned to disrupt the music industry by not relying on major label licensing
premises.evidence_span: we're not relying on major label licensing because we're an original content platform

value.text: Rekrogram empowers aspiring artists to create and share original music affordably
value.evidence_span: the ability to awaken their inner musician

notes: Celebrity relationships and Project Music participation are excluded as traction.
